providers.title: AI translation
providers.subtitle: One key per provider. The selected AI is the one used by the translate buttons.

slots.title: Translation prompt
slots.subtitle: Customize the prompt sent to the AI. Save several in slots and switch between them.
slots.unknownVarsError: Unknown variables (typo?): {{vars}}. Fix or remove them.
slots.reservedError: Reserved sections are appended automatically and cannot appear in the prompt: {{sections}}
slots.lockedNotice: The default prompt cannot be overwritten. Editing it creates a new slot.

tooltip.text: Variables in braces are replaced on each translation. The four required ones must exist in the prompt before it can be saved. In batch translation, {SOURCE_TEXT} receives several numbered lines at once and a mandatory response-format section is appended automatically.

similarity.title: Similarity search
similarity.subtitle: Includes similar past translations as reference examples in the prompt.
similarity.enableDesc: Appends the most similar examples from the translation history to the prompt.
similarity.countDesc: How many of the most similar examples to send. Default: 3.
similarity.minScoreDesc: Examples with a similarity lower than this threshold are discarded.

modal.title: Translate with AI
modal.appendNote: Selected examples are appended to the prompt as reference bullet points.
modal.alsoUpdate: Also update the saved prompt in settings
